title: Allow slideshow wallpapers to be previewed in the same way as static image wallpapers can be previewed
line: In Slideshow mode, each image now has a Preview button that shows it on the desktop with the slideshow's positioning until you apply or close the settings.
explanation: In Image mode, clicking a thumbnail previews it live on the desktop through the internal PreviewImage setting, but the slideshow wallpaper always showed its current slide and its config had no PreviewImage entry, so there was no way to see how a newly added image looks with the slideshow's positioning. Clicking a slide thumbnail only toggles whether it is part of the slideshow. The change adds PreviewImage to the slideshow config, makes the wallpaper show it when set, and adds a Preview on Desktop hover button to each slide; the preview ends on Apply, OK or Cancel like the Image mode one.

commits.message:
wallpapers/slideshow: allow previewing a slide on the desktop

In Slideshow mode there was no way to see how a single image looks with
the slideshow's positioning without switching to Image mode. Each slide
now has a Preview button that shows it on the desktop until Apply/Close.

BUG: 476909

media.caption: Master: hovering a slide only offers Open Containing Folder, clicking it just unchecks it, and the desktop stays on Slide A.
Fix: the new Preview on Desktop button shows the portrait image on the desktop with the slideshow's 'Scaled, keep proportions' positioning and dark background.

reviews.text: Reusing Image mode's PreviewImage mechanism for Slideshow mode with a dedicated 'Preview on Desktop' hover action is clean, preserves click/Enter checkbox toggling, and uses the slideshow's positioning as requested. However, WallpaperDelegate.qml and config.qml are shared with the Screen Locking KCM (kcm_screenlocker), where there is no live desktop preview. As written, the 'Preview on Desktop' button will appear on every slideshow image in Lock Screen settings and do nothing when clicked.
changes: Hide the 'Preview on Desktop' action when config.qml is hosted in the Lock Screen KCM (for example by checking typeof appearanceRoot === 'undefined' via a canPreview property on config.qml, matching line 149).
Consider adding '@action:button' translation context via i18ndc for the new 'Preview on Desktop' tooltip string.

reviews.text: In the desktop's own config dialog the fix does what the reporter asked in c8/c9: a hover action previews a slide on the desktop using the slideshow's Positioning and background, reusing Image mode's PreviewImage path, and clicks still toggle slides. But WallpaperDelegate/config.qml are shared with System Settings' Wallpaper KCM (kcms/wallpaper, which strips PreviewImage from its config loader and doesn't drive the desktop live) and with kscreenlocker's Appearance page (configDialog: kcm). Both report currentWallpaper == org.kde.slideshow, so the new 'Preview on Desktop' button shows up there and does nothing visible. The verify notes only cover the desktop dialog.
changes: Show the Preview on Desktop action only when the config is hosted by the desktop containment's config dialog (where PreviewImage reaches the live wallpaper), or make it work in the Wallpaper KCM; hide it in the lock screen KCM.
Verify in System Settings > Wallpaper and Screen Locking > Appearance with Slideshow selected that no non-working button appears and Apply/needsSave aren't touched by the preview.
